newsitem.title: UK: Vardy, Wiggins to build business park.
newsitem.headline: Vardy, Wiggins to build business park.

text.p: Automotive distributor Reg Vardy Plc said on Wednesday it is to develop a business park in northern England with property developer Wiggins Group Plc.
It said in a statement that its Tyne Tees Properties Ltd unit would develop a 22-acre site in Lancashire, by Junction 34 of the M6 motorway, for office, distribution and industrial use.
Wiggins will take charge of site infrastructure, project management and marketing for the park.
Reg Vardy said a number of companies were already negotiating to move onto the site, which should begin to be occupied in late 1997.
